elements.evidence: "Ono as Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience, for any reasons"

elements.element: Termination right not gated/delayed (available on notice)
elements.evidence: the "Commencing on the later of (i) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale..." gate was deleted
"by giving 30 days' advance written notice to Array"
"Array shall pay Ono a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination"

elements.element: Vendor has no termination-for-convenience right during committed term
elements.evidence: Condition demonstrably absent: Article 13 gives Array only breach-based termination (13.3 "materially breached or defaulted"); no Array convenience right exists
"giving 30 days' advance written notice" (shorter than the 60–90 day fallback band)

elements.element: Early-termination fee not exceeding 3 months' fees
elements.evidence: No early-termination fee is imposed anywhere in 13.2 as revised

elements.element: Vendor may terminate for convenience only at end of a term on 90 days' notice
elements.evidence: No Array convenience-termination provision exists to test

reasons: The preferred level is complete: an unqualified Ono convenience right, a fixed 30 days' written notice, and an express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees; Array is given no convenience right anywhere in Article 13, so that condition is satisfied by absence.

Minimality fails only on drafting surplus: the alias gloss "Ono as Customer" is unnecessary (the sentence already names Ono) and "for convenience," duplicates the retained "for any reasons". The operative fix required only deleting the time-gate, fixing the notice number, and inserting the refund sentence.

Preserves intent is impaired because "Customer" is not a defined term in this Agreement (the definitions use "Party", "Array", "Ono"), so the gloss introduces an undefined term into operative text; recommend reverting to "Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement for any reasons by giving 30 days' advance written notice".
Fallback is not met (30 days is below the 60–90 day band), but that is irrelevant since the locked preferred level is satisfied — do not blend levels.
